title: Don R NDE21883 NDE 21883
content: I locked my keys in my car. I got a ride to town but couldn't get any help and took a taxi back. I apparently got into an argument with the taxi driver and he must have hit me with a black jack. I woke up later on the side of the freeway and could see my car on the other side of the freeway (four lanes each way). I couldn't get across and eventually someone parked behind my car and broke out the window. I yelled for them to stop. The next thing I knew, I was crossing the freeway with cars going up to eighty miles per hour toward me. I crossed two lanes, then a third, and the car in the fourth lane was braking for me. When I realized that I was going to be run over, I jumped up on the hood of the car with my elbow and my head hit the windshield. As soon as this happened, I later remembered yelling, ‘Let me back in, let me back in’. The doctor later told me I had retrograde amnesia and had events confused. Apparently, the split second that my head hit the windshield and I started yelling, I had an out of body experience. I felt myself hovering above my body about ten feet up. I remember a white light but I think that was from the black jack. But I do remember that God spoke to me and said to come with Him. I said, ‘No, I want to marry and have a son and daughter.’ I put that wish in the Wailing Wall in Jerusalem nine years later. I have been happily married for twenty-one years with a daughter and son. I also remember Him telling me to walk to Port Arthur, Texas (my hometown) and don't look back. That's it. I had a mild concussion and burst some blood vessels in my arm. I recovered. In 2002, I went into a ten day diabetic coma. I am now sixty-seven and partially paralyzed on my left side from having a very high blood sugar level.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: God told him "to walk to Port Arthur, Texas (my hometown) and don't look back."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Hit by a car while crossing a freeway after being struck on the head ("black jack") and sustaining a concussion.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: God invited him to come; experiencer refused because he wanted to marry and have children; God gave instruction to walk to Port Arthur, Texas and not look back.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE occurred at moment of head impact; hovering above body; white light; communication with God; refusal/choice to return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: The experiencer attributes the white light possibly to the head injury/black jack rather than the NDE itself; God gave a specific instruction: "walk to Port Arthur, Texas (my hometown) and don't look back."
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Let me back in, let me back in” / “God spoke to me and said to come with Him.” / “No, I want to marry and have a son and daughter.” / “to walk to Port Arthur, Texas (my hometown) and don't look back.”
